scope: Paired reference diagnostic for one prepared free sample day, using all seven fixed Lake Hood recordings.
source_date_selection: The four prepared Lake Hood dates include one first-of-month date eligible for this free sample.
identifier_selection: All aircraft from the existing 288 full-day regional sample snapshots, plus the full-day broad-region production and staging archive identities.

plan.scope: Paired single-day source diagnostic. Every fixed Lake Hood recording searches the complete prepared November 1 sample. The original multi-date benchmark remains separate.
plan.reference_date_selection: The prepared four-day cache contains one date eligible for the free first-of-month sample.
plan.runner_metadata_note: This frozen runner sets recording_date_supplied true whenever provider date discovery is disabled. The actual direct-reference jobs contain no start_utc or archive date arguments. Their finite reference coverage is stated above.

audio.runner_date_flag_explanation: The frozen runner sets this flag when provider date discovery is off. Each direct-reference job was checked to contain no recording date or start time argument. Reference coverage was the complete prepared sample day.

plan.scope: Known-position diagnostic. The camera reference is supplied to isolate local flight/audio compatibility. These results do not count as location acceptance.
plan.range_diagnostic_reason: The initial default-radius result had fewer than six reference passages at the camera area.

interpretation: The denser source added positions but produced no accepted timing location. At the known camera area, the 500 m passage radius had fewer than six reference passages in either source. Point checks at 1, 2, and 5 km returned additional candidate matches. These point checks supplied the camera reference and did not run spatial or shuffled-control acceptance checks.
app_integration: The Rust downloader still uses the standard free sample. These high-resolution files were prepared by the preserved research downloader.
